_readme: Machine-readable art tracker for GCD Tourney. Spec: art/SPEC.md (hi-res sprite spec v2, ADR 0007). Human view: art/TRACKER.md; review queue: art/REVIEW.md (keep all three in sync). Top-level version = manifest format (2 = spec v2 with per-asset version fields). The packer reads spec, animationDefaults, characters and vfx, plus the approvedVersion fields of vfx.effects, worldArt.* batches and sharedUi: world art ships approved items only (ADR 0012). status: todo | raw | packed | approved. version = latest candidate number NN of the asset (file suffix _vNN; 0 = nothing generated yet); approvedVersion = the NN the user approved (null until then). Versions are never reused; rejected candidates move to a _rejected/ folder. Strips: raw/<anim>_vNN.png (the packer uses the highest). References: candidates reference/<name>_vNN.png, the approved one is copied to file (the approved idle strip is also copied to reference/idle_approved.png). UI: candidates raw/ui_<name>_vNN.png, the approved one is copied to file. step = generation order (art/PIPELINE.md). ms = default per-frame durations written to anims.json. animationDefaults = copy-me block for a new character.

decals._readme: Ground-damage decals (ADR 0024, art/decals/README.md). Names, cells, variants, groups, modes and color rules are the engine contract (DECAL_SPECS in tools/pack-decals.mjs; drift is warned). npm run sprites decals packs approved items (approvedVersion here or on worldArt.decal batches) into public/decals/atlas.json + the PNG pages of each page set (at most 4 per match); --candidates writes public/preview/decals/.
decals.candidates: art/decals/raw/<name>_vNN.png, or the parts <name>_vNN_A.png, _B.png, _C.png of one version
